exact_definition: index = round(f * (n - 1)) applied to the sorted population, clamped to [0, n-1]
rationale: The preregistered formula is a rounded-index selection over the sorted population. It is not the conventional nearest-rank order statistic, which selects a different index. Describing it as nearest-rank was a documentation error, not a numerical one.

frozen_results_preserved.note: T1 p95 = 60 cents is preserved because it is correct under the preregistered formula. T0 p95 = 70 cents is preserved as a legitimate distinct-population result. Neither value was changed.

scope_of_correction: documentation/metadata only; no scientific byte changed

summary_json_exception.reason: SUMMARY.json contains the frozen scientific results and is the object of the required SHA-256 verification against the existing backed-up copy. Editing its terminology field would change the accepted scientific bytes and invalidate that verification. It retains the historical wording "nearest-rank" and "abs_delta_cents_nearest_rank" as preserved provenance; this record is the controlling terminology authority.
